scope: Risk-focused semantic comparison of Transformer, trajectory, conclusion and appendix proposals, plus independent main/supplement experiment review. This is not a full mathematical proof-equivalence audit; other agents review those proofs.

Transformer: finite depth including zero, positive epsilon, nonempty key sets and split-input domain retained
exact full construction versus conditioned benchmark and float64 diagnostic limitations retained
LayerNorm additional mean freezing and composite Value-only attention implementation retained
zero-mass cemetery convention and positive-epsilon outside-option remainder retained
ResLRP local nonzero-output/gamma condition and Arras local GELU equivalence retained
Trajectory: signed NRM relevance versus probability and normalization hypotheses retained
contraction hypotheses and cemetery-floor interpretation retained
routing sensitivity versus faithfulness and changing-discount qualification retained
ViT unequal randomization and weak Spearman association versus independence retained
GEF, Spectral, SymbolicXAI and SemanticLens citation scopes retained
Conclusion: scope of vision/benchmark evidence and lack of deployment guarantees retained
Appendix: predicted versus annotated targets and precise sampling protocols retained
VOC recordweighted estimand with image-cluster bootstrap retained
formalization partiality and proof/experiment boundary retained
publication/preprint status and student responsibilities retained
historical and later thesis AI assistance distinguished
